messages:
incident-bot: HIGH SEV - paging failed: notify-proxy returned 502 for outbound pages to PagerDuty. Suppressor flagged and auto-squelched pages. impact: some on-call seats not paged. Investigating now.
ryan: wait, are customers affected or just internal alert delivery?
maria: checking PD activity... `pd logs --since=10m --service=redwood-notify` shows no outbound page events for the last 7m. incoming alerts still in alert-store.
jess: pushed a suppressor regex change ~8m ago to reduce noisy alerts. Could be a bad match that escalated to global suppressor. rolling back now.
ops-bot: deploy: jess reverted suppressor change (deploy id deploy-2024-11-048). rollback started.
oncall-sre: manual page plan: if PD doesn't receive, we'll escalate to SMS. who's oncall? @ryan?
ryan: i'm oncall. i'll trigger manual page after we confirm it's safe. what's the queue status?
maria: run `curl -s http://notify-internal/queue | jq '.pending | length'` output: `3` (stuck). sample item: { "id": "evt-ABCD1234", "status": "queued", "last_error": "502 Bad Gateway" }
sam: 3 queued is fine but they haven't retried. maybe the retry worker died when the suppressor threw a panic. check worker logs: `kubectl logs -l app=notify-worker -n prod --since=15m`
jess: logs show `panic: regexp compile error` at 14:53:12. my regex had an unescaped `]`. that's on me. rolling back fixed config, restarting workers.
oncall-sre: willing to flip suppressor to permissive for 5m to flush queue, but that risks noise.
ryan: do it. i'll coordinate manual pages if PD still hasn't gotten them after restart.
jess: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/notify-worker -n prod` done. suppressor toggled to permissive via `redis-cli HSET notify:suppressor config "permissive:true"`.
maria: worker restarted, logs show retries, now `curl -s http://notify-internal/queue | jq '.pending | length'` -> `0`. queued items retried and delivered (PD ack ids returned).
incident-bot: automated page attempt failed earlier; manual override in progress.
ryan: triggering manual PD pages for the 3 events: `for id in evt-ABCD1234 evt-EFGH5678 evt-IJKL9012; do pd incidents trigger --service redwood-notify --summary "Missed alert $id"; done`
oncall-sre: PD shows incidents created and triggered, recipients got SMS a few moments ago. @jess please open a postmortem and include timeline + regex testcases.
jess: will create postmortem ticket INC-2024-142 and link here. also adding a unit test for suppressor regex parsing.
sam: follow-up actions: (1) add CI lint for suppressor regex, (2) ensure worker restarts on panic, (3) add a short-circuit that bypasses suppressor when delivery backlog > 50. i've created tickets: TKT-306, TKT-307, TKT-308.
maria: customer impact: no external user-facing outages reported; internal monitoring alerts may have been delayed up to ~6m. we'll mark SEV: high-internal.
ryan: thanks all. please add the PD incident numbers to the postmortem once available. closing live mitigation, keeping thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
